posts.name: carnilius
posts.cooked: The wording on Santa Guise's incap side says "Flip 1 face-down card", not one face-down hero card.  As far as I know, this is the only way to flip an arbitrary face down card.  Certainly this can work advantageously against Guise's nemesis Wager Master as you can return a favorable condition card into play, but where else can this be used?  Can you flip face down cards that are under other cards, like from La Capitan or Savage Mana?

Sure you could flip the cards over under la capitan or savage mana. but they are still "under" those other cards and would continue to not have text.

The flip a card thing really is a call to his nemesis Wager Master. EmoSpite also has his drugs you could flip, though not sure why you would want to do that.
